findings_and_corrections: Owner rejected first192 arm length and human-like hands. Shortened the trial arms, retaining a modest increase over191 and fuller lower volume.
Removed fingers, knuckles, separated digits and grip shapes. Built continuous Round, Mitten and Paddle palms.
First abstract palms were too similar at ordinary scale. Improved the silhouettes through a local wrist taper and greater palm width; no additional long appendage.
Reviewed saved/reopened native fronts, both profiles and rears of all14 tops; representative hand fronts, profiles, rear and underside. No additional sleeve penetration or broken wrist join observed.
Inspected exported assemblies: all14 tops from five angles,44 top/bottom front pairs,42 hand/top front pairs, and all three hand studies on both builds from five angles.

Close rear review caught lateral waistband flare on lowered female Shorts/Pants. Garment rays had reached attached arms. Replaced that support query with torso-only geometry and corrected only the waistband sides.

An initial smoothed waist correction left a small lateral residual. Direct torso fitting removed it; final16-direction clearance checks passed. Waist heights, lower geometry, crotch, hems and body remain unchanged by this correction.

Recaptured65 affected views after the final waist fix, including all8 female tops with both lowered bottoms from front, side and rear, plus pasties and bare waistband views. Rechecked native full-quality side/rear renders and the exported assemblies. No remaining obvious flare, gaps or adjacent intersections observed in those views.

Checked all four eye shapes on both builds, Almond at additional angles and all four skin tones, pasties through seven views/four tones, and32/48/64/128px portraits. Original/Round/Soft square unchanged; revised Almond retains the dark cartoon finish.
